method: Read every scoped hi value with its English source and the English context sidecar (role, tone, length, placeholders, maxCells) at the audited head.
Byte-compared en and hi; every exact match among the scoped values classified as an IDENTICAL_OK technical/product token or as a stub. Stubs: 0.

Parsed every scoped value with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser; compared argument names/styles, number/date skeletons, plural/select option sets, tag names and # nodes; then rendered every plural/select message through intl-messageformat at hi counts 0, 1, 2 and 5 (168 renders, 0 errors).
Checked hi CLDR categories: every plural has one and other (plus explicit =0/=2..=6 where the source has them); 0 selects one; no few/many/zero/ordinal arms.

Compared every {placeholder}, ICU structure, markup token, backtick span and newline; checked NFC, manual bidi controls, Devanagari digits, ZWJ/ZWNJ, duplicate JSON keys, terminal punctuation and danda usage.

Scanned the full scope for glossary/register drift: session, agent, subagent/child, tool, transcript, approvals, project, model, prompt, compaction, schedule, monitor, wake, job, runtime, credential, workspace, team, skill, surface, manager; address form आप only, no तुम/तू, no '!'.

Read call sites for values whose meaning depended on composition (subagent section prefix, archive failure toast, approval instruction, turn-summary duration, device-picker heading, quote action, canonical chat).

Read the translator receipt but did not treat its summaries as evidence; all findings above were verified from catalogue bytes and code at the audited head. No rendered-frame pass and no native-speaker sign-off are claimed.

mechanical.terminal_punctuation_note: 19 terminal differences were reviewed: 18 are intentional fragment-introducing colons or the source’s ASCII "..." rendered as U+2026; 1 is the dropped final danda in F-14.

identical_summary.classification: All 88 are language-neutral tokens: placeholders/format skeletons, CSS/utility selectors, keyboard glyphs, product names (Local Operator), OS folder names (Program Files/ProgramData/Users), file-format acronyms (PDF), sampling parameter names (Top K/Top P, kept English by all seven locales), and composition fragments whose text is entirely {arguments}. None is an untranslated English sentence.

verdict_reason: No blockers: all 1,795 values are present, every placeholder/ICU arm/markup token survives, hi plural categories are correct, and there are no stubs. Five majors are visible-copy defects that need correction before the namespace is ledger-eligible: the subagent section prefix, the archive-failure toast composition, the quote action's false friend, the reversed MCP key-sharing sentence, and the approval instruction naming English buttons that are not on screen.

findings.reason: The value is a bare prefix concatenated before the owner name (run-child-subagents.tsx renders prefix{ownerLabel}), so 'के उप-एजेंट' renders as 'के उप-एजेंट Alice' — a postposition stranded before its noun. 'उप-एजेंट:' reads 'उप-एजेंट: Alice' and keeps the section label's meaning.

The toast composes 'Could not {action} “title”' with {action} = the imperative 'संग्रहित करें'/'संग्रह हटाएँ'; the Hindi string yields 'संग्रहित करें “X” नहीं हो सका', an imperative followed by a passive failure. The proposed template plus verbal-noun actions reads '“X” को संग्रहित नहीं किया जा सका'.
'कोट करें' uses कोट (a coat) as a transliteration of 'quote'; it is a false friend, not the Hindi verb. All seven other locales translate the action (fr Citer, es Citar, ru Цитировать, ur اقتباس).
